chunks: As for what Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the two rakʿahs of the obligatory tawaf. He said: Their time is when you finish your tawaf, and I consider it disliked at the yellowing of the sun and at its rising.

key_terms.اصْفِرَارِ الشَّمْسِ: the time when the sun becomes yellow near setting
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ: the two units of prayer being discussed
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf for which these two rakʿahs are performed

ai.seo_question: When should the two rakʿahs of obligatory tawaf be performed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the time of the two rakʿahs performed after the obligatory tawaf. It states that their proper time is immediately after completing the tawaf, while performing them at sunrise and when the sun turns yellow is considered disliked.
